description: Task 7: Version bump to v7.6.0 and update all documentation (README.md, README_EN.md, docs/CHANGELOG.md).

2. In dashboard/app.py change the FastAPI app version='7.5.0' to '7.6.0', and all other occurrences of 7.5.0 in that file (version-info div, CSS/JS query params).

4. In dashboard/templates/index.html update the Engine v7.5.0 reference to v7.6.0.

7. In docs/CHANGELOG.md: prepend a v7.6.0 entry above v7.5.0 with all new features documented.
8. Commit with message: 'docs: 升级至v7.6.0+更新文档和CHANGELOG'
